correctness.rationale: For Y=Bl_S(P²×P²) along smooth Enriques S, the integral codimension-2 blowup formula splits H⁴(Y) as pullback H⁴(X) plus Gysin H²(S). Projection formula makes summands orthogonal; Gysin self-intersection makes exceptional form −Num(S). The ambient Gram matrix in (h1²,h2²,h1h2) is U⊕〈1〉; the Enriques free form is U⊕E8(−1). Thus free middle form is U²⊕E8(+1)⊕〈1〉, rank13, determinant1, odd, signature (11,2). The indefinite odd unimodular lattice classification identifies I_{11,2}. Independently computed displayed exact E8 Gram rank/determinant/signature. Torsion Z/2 in H⁴ is deliberately excluded; no cohomology-ring or diffeomorphism claim.

originality.rationale: Tufo’s Theorem 3.1/Corollary 3.2 states blowup and additive H⁴ including 2-torsion, not the integral cup-product isometry class. Dolgachev states Num(Enriques)=U⊕E8(−1), not this Fano fourfold invariant. A general blowup formula permits deduction once the new variety and its center are identified; the resulting exact lattice classification is an explicit new specialization of standard tools, not a new universal lattice theorem. No Resultary exact overlap found.
residual_risks: Universal blow-up Gysin formula and Enriques lattice make calculation short; equivalent specialization may exist in topological literature not indexed.
No claim beyond free H⁴ lattice or about 2-torsion linking structure.

value.rationale: The free middle cup-product lattice is a canonical topological invariant of a newly constructed Fano fourfold. Despite use of familiar blowup/Gysin methods, the exact isometry class and parity/signature refinement the known additive cohomology and permit comparison of Enriques-host fourfold topology; no broader claimed theorem is required.
